candidates.title: Configure rate limits for AI traffic on AgentCore gateway
candidates.summary: Learn how to configure rate limits on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway to enforce per-user and per-target traffic controls. Define request, token, and connection limits scoped by JWT claims or IAM identity to protect downstream models, tools, and agents from traffic spikes.

candidates.title: Securing AI agents with temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore let you define stateful rules that evaluate authorization based on an agent's session history. Learn how to enforce workflow sequencing, prevent data fabrication, cap financial exposure, and require human approval for high-value actions.
